movelist.name: Shadow Ball
movelist.effect: Shadow Ball lowers the foe’s Special Defense 1 Combat Stage on 17+.

movelist.name: Scary Face
movelist.effect: The target’s Speed is lowered 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Power Split
movelist.effect: The target has their Attack and Special Attack lowered by 5. If they do, the user gains a +5 bonus to Damage Rolls. These effects last until the end of the scene.

movelist.name: Guard Split
movelist.effect: The target loses 5 Defense and 5 Special Defense. If they do, the user gains 5 Damage Reduction. These effects last until the end of the scene.

movelist.name: Curse
movelist.effect: If the user is not a Ghost Type, Curse has a Frequency of EOT, and when used the user lowers its Speed by -1 Combat Stage, but raises Attack and Defense by +1 Combat Stage each.  If the user is a Ghost Type, Curse has a Frequency of Scene, and when used the user loses 1/3rd of their Max Hit Points and a target Pokémon or Trainer within 8 meters of the user becomes Cursed. This Hit Point loss cannot be prevented in any way.

movelist.name: Ominous Wind
movelist.effect: On 19+, the user has each of its stats raised by +1 Combat Stage.

abilities.name: Mummy
abilities.trigger: The user is hit by a Melee Attack
abilities.effect: Disable one of the user’s Abilities for the rest of the Scene or until they are switched out.

abilities.name: Stall
abilities.effect: In a round’s queue, a Pokémon with Stall is always last. If a Pokémon goes to the end of the queue, the Pokémon with Stall is still the last to move. The user’s actions taken on their Initiative Count (not Priority or Interrupt) cannot be Interrupted.

abilities.name: Cursed Body
abilities.trigger: The user is hit by a Damaging Move.
